summary: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K solely to disclose its election of home country practice exemptions under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5615(a)(3). The exemptions cover independent director majority, annual/interim reporting, and shareholder approval requirements for acquisitions, change of control, equity compensation, discounted issuances, and voting rights. A legal opinion from Cayman counsel, Ogier, is attached. No transaction, event, or special situation is announced. This is a routine corporate governance notice with no deal terms or actionable event.
